findings.title: Account UI message switched from i18next placeholders to Java MessageFormat
findings.body: error-invalid-multivalued-size was changed from Attribute {{0}} / {{1}} / {{2}} (i18next interpolation used by account-ui) to Attribute {0} ... {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}. The account console will no longer substitute the attribute name and bounds, and will show the raw {0}/{1}/{2} tokens and choice-pattern text to users. The same placeholder rewrite is in js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties around line 3139.

findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian copy
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Lithuanian account bundle was changed from a Lithuanian sentence to "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:" (Italian). Lithuanian users setting up OTP will see the wrong language. The same Italian string was written into themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties line 71 (loginTotpStep1), which previously had a correct Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese totpStep1 replaced with Traditional Chinese
findings.body: The zh_CN account totpStep1 value is now "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：", which is Traditional Chinese (手機, 應用程式), not Simplified Chinese. The previous zh_CN string was Simplified, and the zh_CN login bundle uses a Simplified equivalent. Mainland Chinese users will see the wrong script on the account OTP setup step.

findings.title: Illegal-HTML diff snippet can throw and abort verification
findings.body: When sanitized and value differ, the prefix/suffix trim can overlap: start can advance past value.length() - end (for example value "aaa" vs sanitized "aa"). value.substring(start, value.length() - end) then throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException from inside the key iterator. verify() only catches IOException, so the Maven plugin crashes with a stack trace instead of recording the Illegal HTML message, and later keys in the file are not checked.

findings.title: Message bundles decoded as ISO-8859-1, not UTF-8
findings.body: PropertyResourceBundle(InputStream) always decodes properties as ISO-8859-1. Theme files in this repo are UTF-8 (Arabic, Chinese, Lithuanian, and so on) and are not unicode-escaped. The HTML check therefore runs on mojibake. The OWASP sanitizer can normalize or entity-encode those characters so unescapeHtml4 does not restore the original, producing false "Illegal HTML" failures, or it can hide real markup that only appears after a correct UTF-8 decode. Use an InputStreamReader with UTF-8 (PropertyResourceBundle(Reader)).
